name: Overturn
description: Capture what Fin or a teammate drafted, what was sent, and why, as a replayable case.

draft_inputs.composer: The unsent reply text, when the companion integration can supply it.
draft_inputs.draft.origin: draft:ai, draft:manual or draft:unknown. Omit it and Overturn records unknown.
draft_inputs.assist: true only when an assist (for example Fin) wrote the draft.
